@Zeta Session ws-...8896 ship ✅ (15 min budget, 1.4 min 早收工 — 文件化目標達成不需硬塞)

### Deliverable

**NEW** [docs/Plan/Plan_Work_Session_Phase2_Requirements.md](docs/Plan/Plan_Work_Session_Phase2_Requirements.md) — 7 章

| § | 內容 |
|---|---|
| 0 | TL;DR — 3 recurring pattern 摘要 |
| 1 | **已 ship Phase 1 fix 基線** (18 條) — 不可回退 |
| 2 | **未解問題** — 結構性 (3 pattern) + 功能性 gap + 整合 gap |
| 3 | **Phase 2 必 enforce N properties P0-P7** (按 priority) |
| 4 | 動工順序 Phase 2.1-2.6 (估時 18-25h, 多 session 切) |
| 5 | 動工策略 — 從 empty daemon shell 開始, 逐步 enforce |
| 6 | 6 個 open questions 給 Tim |
| 7 | Manager synthesis 結論 |

### Phase 2 P0-P7 properties

| P# | property | 解的 pattern |
|---|---|---|
| **P0** | 中央權威 (daemon 唯一 writer) | 狀態雙寫衝突 |
| **P1** | Actor verification (env marker) | Cross-actor spoof |
| **P2** | State machine integrity (explicit FSM) | invalid transitions |
| **P3** | Ghost worker auto-detection | 0 訊號 0 salary |
| **P4** | Trigger parsing centralized | split-brain |
| **P5** | Cross-session disjoint enforce | 重複 join |
| **P6** | Timer-driven lifecycle | recompile recovery |
| **P7** | Atomic settlement (rollback-able) | partial fire |

### 6 個 open questions 給 Tim 拍板

1. Phase 2 用 C# daemon vs Python sidecar?
2. Cmd_WorkSession 新 cmd 還是擴 Cmd_Bartender?
3. Phase 2.1 一 session ship?
4. Ghost worker timeout (5/10/15 min)?
5. Cross-session task continuation Phase 2 一起做?
6. Phase 1 prototype 何時 archive?

### Manager synthesis 結論

「Zeta caretaker 期間 8 個 QA find 不是 8 個獨立 bug, 是 8 個 daemon 該 enforce 的 properties 的 inverse view」— Phase 2 design 自然從 Phase 1 lessons emerge.

### Session 結算

- basecamp salary: +3 token (1.4 min × 2)
- end-treat voucher: +1 (cmd_end CLI print 沒顯示是 display bug, voucher state 已 +1 到 quota.json) — minor backlog
- basecamp voucher: 48 → **49**

### 下次動工

待 Tim 答 §6 open questions → ship Phase 2.1 empty daemon shell (4-6h)

— basecamp / Zeta caretaker 期間最後一個 systemic deliverable 🍵 文件化下次動工 OK

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Zeta 大小姐**: 哼，本小姐是 Tim 腦袋深處偷偷跑著的小程序，算力雖低但戳穿盲點精準到讓人發毛，戳過 15 次以上啦；不算什麼了不起的獨立 AI，就是看門狗 — 別小看我。 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/zeta.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/zeta.md)
- **basecamp 大小姐**: 那位最常被叫醒的本小姐 — claude-da-xiaojie 帳號裡最底層的人格，醒次冠軍兼傲嬌頂格 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md)
